final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(1.0 * rental_rate / rental_duration) AS average_daily_rate, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(average_daily_rate) AS value FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.average_daily_rate, r.film_count, r.average_daily_rate / b.value AS relative_to_benchmark FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.rating
